title: Monitor Accuracy Isn't the Answer: A Decision-Value Framework for Evaluating AI Agent Restart Monitors
abstract: arXiv:2610.36544v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Classification accuracy and true-positive and false-positive rates alone do not determine whether restarting an AI agent improves success. Using an exact alarm-to-action identity for an independent clean restart with zero monitoring overhead, we show analytically that a monitor with fixed 90% accuracy can swing from a five-percentage-point loss to a 35-point gain in success rate, depending solely on the replacement attempt's residual-budget success probability. We introduce two techniques for evaluating monitors and progress signals in decision terms. First, a decision-sufficiency criterion, a binary-action specialization of Blackwell's comparison of experiments, identifies which progress representations or context compressions preserve the information needed to choose optimally between the specified actions, independent of trace reconstruction fidelity. translated_title: 监控准确率并非答案：评估AI智能体重启监控器的决策价值框架
translated_abstract: 分类准确率以及真阳性率和假阳性率本身并不能决定重启AI智能体是否能提高成功率。利用一种针对零监控开销的独立干净重启的精确“警报-行动”恒等式，我们从分析上证明，一个固定90%准确率的监控器，仅因替换尝试的剩余预算成功概率不同，就能使成功率从损失五个百分点变为提升三十五个百分点。我们引入了两种以决策术语评估监控器和进度信号的技术。第一，决策充分性准则——Blackwell实验比较理论在二元行动上的特化版本——用于识别哪些进度表示或上下文压缩能够保留在指定行动之间做出最优选择所需的信息，而不依赖于轨迹重建的保真度。第二，有限样本、无模型的决策审计使用同时二项区间（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出一个决策价值框架，从分析上证明监控器的分类准确率本身无法决定重启AI智能体是否有益，并引入决策充分性准则和有限样本无模型决策审计两种技术，以决策价值的角度评估AI智能体重启监控器。
